elements.label: Attio app icon inserted between words

elements.manual_reason: The faint grid background fades in across the whole frame; no candidate box covers the full frame.
elements.label: Grid background

pattern.description: The headline words 'Every' and 'note' part horizontally to open a gap, and the dark Attio app icon pops in at the centre, growing from a tiny square to full size; a light grid background fades in at the same time.
pattern.why_premium: The words make room for the icon in one coordinated motion, so the brand mark becomes part of the sentence rather than an overlay; the icon grows with a soft settle and the grid adds depth without competing.

build_hint.gsap: tl.to('.word-left', {x: -60, duration: 0.35, ease: 'power3.inOut'}).to('.word-right', {x: 60, duration: 0.35, ease: 'power3.inOut'}, '<').fromTo('.icon', {scale: 0, opacity: 0}, {scale: 1, opacity: 1, duration: 0.35, ease: 'back.out(1.2)'}, '<0.08').fromTo('.grid', {opacity: 0}, {opacity: 1, duration: 0.4, ease: 'power1.out'}, '<')
build_hint.remotion: const s = spring({frame: frame - 3, fps, config: {damping: 18, stiffness: 200, mass: 1}}); icon scale = s; left word translateX = interpolate(s, [0, 1], [0, -60]); right word = interpolate(s, [0, 1], [0, 60]); grid opacity = interpolate(frame, [0, 12], [0, 1], {extrapolateRight: 'clamp'}).

notes: Pattern chip_append is an approximate fit (an inline brand icon inserted into a headline); a dedicated 'inline icon insert' pattern may be worth proposing. Grid background uses a manual full-frame box. Whether the icon overshoots cannot be told from the filmstrip; b03 OCR text '00' is a misread of the icon glyph.
